exclusiveFromGanka.title: Exclusive from Ganka
exclusiveFromGanka.description: As an artist, film director, author, and participant in art projects, Ganka knows perfectly what the intense rhythm of life means and how important it is sometimes to pause and enjoy every moment. This individual experience is translated into exclusive custom collections. The artist does not limit herself to collaborating with corporate partners. She also works with individual orders. Together with Ganka, you can create unique family porcelain that will bring a sense of celebration and warmth to your home and will be passed down through generations.

stayInTouch.title: Stay in Touch with Ganka
stayInTouch.description: The Ganka for Home collections combine images of Ukrainian and world culture with the artist's imaginative world. Every year, new series of works appear and new stories from previous collections are created, supplemented with new items and forms.

giftPackaging.title: Gift packaging
giftPackaging.description: Gift boxes will additionally create a festive atmosphere and highlight the artistic value of Ganka for Home dishes. Each collection has its own unique packaging color.
